description:
Fullstack Software Developer (Mid-Level)


We are seeking a talented Fullstack Software Developer to join our development team. This is an excellent opportunity for a mid-level developer looking to work with modern technologies in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in the design, development, and testing of software applications
  • Collaborate with team members to implement new features and improve existing functionality
  • Debug code and troubleshoot software issues
  • Participate in team meetings and contribute ideas to project discussions
  • Work with senior developers to continuously improve your skills

Requirements:

Must Have:

• 2-3 years of professional software development experience
• Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive web design
• Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)

• Strong proficiency in React and TypeScript
• Experience with RESTful API integration, authentication, and error handling   
• Basic knowledge of Node.js with willingness to learn NestJS
• Experience with SQL databases and writing queries

• Mandatory working from the office (no option for remote work)

Advantage for experience with NestJS and PostgreSQL.

We offer a very dynamic and pleasant working environment, professional development, net income based on exprience and work output, periodically salary upgrades.

Good to know that:

  • We are a very cool team with inteligent and friendly colleagues, a strong team (aprox 25) 
  • We have great infrastructure and latest technology tools;
  • Working hours from 9:30 to 18:30 with lunch break from 13 to 14 ocl;
  • We develop inovative projects and we have more than 15 years experience in engagement and interactive tactics; 
  • Our offices are in a beautiful villa in sector 1. 


If you are passionate about software development and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply for the Fullstack Software Developer Join us in shaping the future of technology!
